entries.title: PostReady: PR #787 — Review quote card renders in natural case, not ALL CAPS
entries.description: Fixed the testimonial review-to-post quote card rendering in ALL CAPS. Quote style now uses natural case so testimonials read as typed — more readable and authentic.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #786 — Carousel → Post Packs materialization + list badge
entries.description: A saved carousel now lands in Post Packs as a labeled carousel pack ready to act on (Part A: materialization + list badge). Publishing is Part B, coming next.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #788 — Review quote: Inter font + longer excerpt (140 chars)
entries.description: Follow-up to natural-case fix: swapped Anton for Inter (heavy) on the quote card for cleaner mixed-case readability, and raised the excerpt cap from 60 to 140 chars.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #789 — Carousel multi-image publishing per platform (gated off)
entries.description: Built carousel (multi-image) posting for all six platforms wired into the headless publish flow, gated off behind CAROUSEL_PUBLISH_ENABLED (default off) until Meta/LinkedIn production API approval lands. Non-carousel publishing is unchanged.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #790 — Shorten Snapchat card subtitle
entries.description: Shortened the subtitle text on the Snapchat platform card for a cleaner, more compact appearance in the carousel.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #791 — Motion Post result UI: submit → poll → preview & download (G3 #699)
entries.description: Built the full Motion Post result UI — the submit flow now polls for video generation completion, then surfaces a preview player and download button. Completes G3 of the Bring to Life epic (#699).

entries.title: PostReady: PR #792 — Motion Post engine: real Bring to Life video generation (#698)
entries.description: Wired the Motion Post engine to actually generate Bring to Life videos — the full generation pipeline (prompt → model call → asset storage → result) is now live. Completes epic item #698.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #794 — Motion Post: clean download via proxy + consistent copy
entries.description: Two fixes from Pete's first live Motion Post: (1) Download used a direct r2.dev fetch that CORS-blocks — now proxied through /api/generate-video/download so it saves cleanly. (2) Copy mismatch aligned on Download.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #795 — Motion Post saves to Post Packs as own item
entries.description: A finished Motion Post ("Bring to Life") can now be saved into Post Packs as its own, separate item — non-destructively. The original still's pack is never touched; the Motion Post gets its own dedicated pack entry.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #796 — Real Living Photo (cinemagraph) single-element motion
entries.description: Shipped real Living Photo generation — single-element cinemagraph motion (#764). Bring to Life now supports both full Motion Posts and targeted single-element Living Photos, completing the Bring to Life epic.
